_doc: NAMED NPC ROSTER. Loaded by World.NpcRoster, placed by ArenaBuilderEmberfall.BuildDataNpcs.
role: quest (QuestGiverNPC, uses questNpcId) | vendor (VendorNPC) | townsfolk (TownsfolkNPC, barks).
x/z are world coords, yaw degrees. model is a generated-visual folder (HeroMale/HeroFemale/Goblin);
a robed capsule (robeHex tint) stands in when the model is missing. Add NPCs here, no builder edit.
Edit + rebuild the scene (AldenFall > Build Emberfall Demo) to place changes.

barks: Please, has anyone seen my Mira?
The warcamp took her. I cannot go alone.
The roads are not safe. Trade is failing.
Hold the gate if the horns sound.
The dead should rest. Lately they do not.
Say a word for the fallen, traveler.
Ale and rumors, both fresh at the Ember Rest.
Bounties on the board, coin for the brave.
Quiet enough tonight. Long may it hold.
Lake's been strange. Pulled up a stone warm as a coal.
Cast from the east bank, they bite at dusk.
Wanna see me dance? Course you do!
